A wedding feast in the courtyard of a modest house in Cana in Galilee. In the foreground Mary (on the LEFT) leans towards Jesus (on the RIGHT) and quietly tells him that the wine has run out; her face is concerned, one hand slightly open towards a small empty clay wine jug and empty earthenware cups on the low table between them. Jesus, seated, turns his face to her, calm and attentive. In the soft background, a few guests and a canopy are only hinted at with light washes. Medium shot at seated eye level.

PEOPLE AND OBJECTS (keep exactly):
- Mary, the mother of Jesus: clearly one generation older than her adult son, grey streaks in her dark hair visible under the veil, gentle lines around eyes and mouth, slightly stooped posture; blue-grey veil and blue-grey robe.

No halo. He is the only person wearing terracotta-red.
